sources.entry: gobookmarks - Landing page to display bookmarks stored in GitHub, GitLab or local Git. AGPL-3.0 Go/Docker

summary.one_liner: A self-hosted personal start page that renders bookmarks from a plaintext file stored in GitHub, GitLab, a local Git repo, or SQL.
summary.what_it_does: Renders a multi-tab, multi-page landing page from a simple plaintext bookmarks format using Category, Column, Page, Tab and horizontal-rule directives. Bookmarks are saved to a file in a GitHub or GitLab repository, a local Git repository, or a SQL database (MySQL or SQLite). Provides a visual drag-and-drop editor and a full-text editor, with edits checked against the file SHA to detect conflicting changes. Offers keyboard-driven search across the current tab, with shortcuts for switching tabs and pages. Keeps git-style history so earlier versions can be browsed or rolled back, and caches favicons on disk. Includes a CLI with a lint command for strict syntax checks and convert commands between the native format and JSON.
use_cases: Sharing a bookmark landing page across devices
how_to_run: docker run -p 8080:8080 -v /my/cache:/var/cache/gobookmarks -v /my/db:/var/lib/gobookmarks -e EXTERNAL_URL= -e GITHUB_CLIENT_ID=abc -e GITHUB_SECRET=def -e FAVICON_CACHE_DIR=/var/cache/gobookmarks/favcache -e LOCAL_GIT_PATH=/var/lib/gobookmarks/localgit ghcr.io/arran4/gobookmarks
Or download a precompiled binary from GitHub Releases
notable: Bookmarks live in a plaintext file you own, backed by Git, so there is no lock-in
Multiple login providers: database, local Git, GitHub, GitLab
Search widgets via a search: URL scheme with $query substitution
Lint and convert CLI commands intended for CI/CD pipelines
Systemd and FreeBSD rc.d service files included in release packages
caveats: GitHub and GitLab logins require creating OAuth2 applications and setting client credentials
The SQL provider stores only the latest bookmarks; full commit history lives in a separate history table
Legacy migration from goa4web-bookmarks requires manually running a SQL script
